problem.h: Your headings blend into the page
p: You spend ages on a journal spread or a handmade card, and the title just sits there in black.
Metallic paint pens can be messy and smelly, and they rarely give you a pretty brush stroke.
A flexible brush tip gives you thick and thin strokes depending on how hard you press, which is the whole secret to brush lettering.
The water-based, low-odour ink dries to a soft metallic shine that catches the light.

faq: Do they work on dark paper?
Metallic ink tends to look its best on dark or kraft paper and card, where the shine really stands out. They also work on white.
Yes. A brush tip makes thick and thin strokes easy. Try pressing harder on the downstrokes and lighter on the upstrokes.
How long do they take to dry?
Give them a moment longer than a normal pen, as metallic ink sits on top of the paper.
They’re water-based and low odour, but they’re designed for older children and adults rather than little ones.
